crossRefs.note: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.
Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.
I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail…
Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness…
I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have…
They didn’t prevail. No place was found for them any more in heaven.
The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole…

translations.web: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
translations.bsb: many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.
translations.kjv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed
translations.asv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up: Yet they have not prevailed against me.
